intro.headline: Engineering leader building calm, reliable software
intro.about:
I lead teams that turn ambiguous problems into dependable products.

Over two decades I have moved between hands-on engineering and leadership, always favouring clear writing and small, steady steps.

This profile is synthetic sample data used for development.

experience.title: VP Engineering
experience.description:
Lead a 60-person engineering organisation across four product areas.
• Reduced incident count by 40% through an on-call overhaul
• Introduced quarterly written planning
- Grew senior hiring pipeline

experience.title: Director of Engineering
experience.description:
Managed three teams building the core platform.

Owned the migration from a monolith to services.

experience.title: Advisory Board, technology advisor
experience.description: Advised the founders on platform architecture and hiring.  – Reviewed the 2019 technical due diligence – Coached two first-time engineering managers  – Sat on the quarterly board review  Stack: Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka.  Internal title: Technical Advisor

experience.title: Principal Engineer
experience.description:
Designed event-driven ingestion handling 2B events per day.
* Mentored eight engineers
* Wrote the internal architecture guidelines

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.description: Built internal tooling and an early e-commerce back office.
